svg.title: FlickrGroupAddr Plugin Code Generation
svg.desc: The authoritative simplified happy-path interaction map for an authenticated browser listing and auditing its Plugin Code records, creating one canonical grouped FGA installation credential with an atomic audit event, and visually comparing it on the same workstation before LrC Password Store persistence.

text.tspan: Authority: Normative happy-path interaction map (ADR 0006, ADR 0039, ADR 0040, ADR 0041, ADR 0044); controlling sources own omitted failures, recent authentication, revocation, and later Bearer verification.
